correctness.rationale: The six-point block family was checked against the defining graph-CFF conditions. For the lower bound, the definition is exactly equivalent to 84 row-witness requirements for \(K_{3,4}\): two separation witnesses per edge and, for every third vertex, a row with that vertex equal to one and the edge endpoints zero. The verifier enumerates all 128 binary row patterns, removes only coverage-dominated patterns, and performs complete branching; independent replay reproduced nonexistence with five rows and existence with six. The same exhaustive method reproduces \(t(K_{2,2})=4\), \(t(K_{2,3})=5\), \(t(K_{2,4})=6\), and \(t(K_{3,3})=6\), which are exactly the smaller nontrivial complete-bipartite cases needed for minimum-order strictness.
